notes: Pack openings now tell you when a pull was a duplicate instead of looking like a brand-new card. Also gave Renewed Faith its own dedicated card art instead of a placeholder, and the Recovery Academy tutorial got a full personality pass.
fixes: A pulled card that you already owned at its copy limit was silently converted to Vials, but the pack reveal and bulk-open results showed it exactly like a brand-new card. Both screens now stamp a "DUPLICATE +N VIALS" badge on any pull that got converted to currency instead.

Renewed Faith (JD-012) was missing dedicated card art and was silently falling back to a generic placeholder image everywhere it appeared. It now has its own artwork matching the rest of the Hope class.
features: The Recovery Academy tutorial's 11 lessons now have named mentors (Dawn, Marcus, Priya, Theo, and Dean Alvarez) with a consistent voice and running through-line, an in-character opening and closing line for every lesson, a small gold celebration beat when you complete a lesson, and a smooth fade between lessons instead of an instant cut.
upcoming_events: More seasonal content and cards are in development — check back after future updates for details.
